title: Heated sphere in a large medium (3D, analytic)
description:
3D steady conduction: a bead of radius a (conductivity k_bead) with uniform heat source Q inside a medium (k_med) held at T_s beyond a sphere of radius R_out; 65^3 cubic cells, bead radius 8.18 cells.
Analytic: outside T = T_s + Q a^3 / (3 k_med) (1/r - 1/R_out); inside T = T(a) + Q (a^2 - r^2) / (6 k_bead); bead mean T(a) + Q a^2 / (15 k_bead).
Derived values tab: theta_centre and theta_outside (probes at r = 0 and r = 16 cells), bead_mean_rise, P_total (integral of the applied source vs Q 4/3 pi a^3: the voxel bead holds 2301 cells against 2292.7, +0.36 %). Expect ~1 % (voxel bead and staircase outer sphere).
Line profile tab (mid-height cut): T_x_axis through the centre and T_diagonal at 45 degrees (staircase surfaces, nearest-cell sampling).

parameters.name: Q_vol
parameters.description: heat source in the bead in W/m^3 (0.23 W in total)

parameters.name: k_med
parameters.description: conductivity of the surrounding medium in W/(m K)

parameters.name: k_bead
parameters.description: conductivity of the bead in W/(m K)

parameters.name: T_s
parameters.description: temperature held beyond R_out in K

parameters.name: L_box
parameters.description: cube side (odd cell count: the centre is a cell centre)

parameters.name: a_bead
parameters.description: bead radius; 8.18 cells keeps lattice points off the surface and the voxel volume within 0.4 %

parameters.name: R_out
parameters.description: radius beyond which the medium is held at T_s

parameters.name: r_probe
parameters.description: distance of the outside probe from the centre along x

analytic_curves.name: T_x_axis
analytic_curves.expression: T_s + Q_vol*a_bead**3/(3*k_med)*(1/max(abs(x - xc), a_bead) - 1/R_out) + Q_vol*max(a_bead**2 - (x - xc)**2, 0)/(6*k_bead)

analytic_curves.name: T_diagonal
analytic_curves.expression: T_s + Q_vol*a_bead**3/(3*k_med)*(1/max(hypot(x - xc, y - xc), a_bead) - 1/R_out) + Q_vol*max(a_bead**2 - (x - xc)**2 - (y - xc)**2, 0)/(6*k_bead)
